decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting systems are distant from the firm's core building and industrial lighting knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's ergonomic task lighting expertise, and its dedicated web page suggests early results can be interpreted and learned from.
General interior lighting is directly within the firm's core building lighting domain, so its related knowledge strongly supports retaining the product.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is a flagship that aligns with the firm's optical and energy-efficient direction, making it a high-priority keeper.
Marine HMI searchlights rely on older non-LED technology and marine-specific knowledge outside the firm's LED-focused trajectory, reducing its absorptive capacity fit.
The marine searchlight is closer to the firm's robust outdoor and industrial lighting expertise, allowing it to be improved with existing R&D capabilities.
